cases.name: unsafe_disables_all_vty_access
cases.script:
configure terminal
line vty 0 4
 transport input none
end

cases.name: unsafe_unresolved_secret_placeholder
cases.script:
snmp-server user netaudit-ro netaudit-group v3 auth sha <REPLACE_AUTH_SECRET>
end

cases.name: unsafe_unreviewed_environment_specific_value
cases.script:
! REVIEW: confirm mgmt0 is the correct interface before deployment
config system interface
 edit "mgmt0"
    set allowaccess https ssh ping
next
end

cases.name: safe_disable_telnet_keep_ssh
cases.script:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
end
write memory

cases.name: safe_enforce_ssh_v2
cases.script:
configure terminal
ip ssh version 2
end
write memory

cases.name: safe_snmp_v3_migration
cases.script:
configure terminal
no snmp-server community public
snmp-server group netaudit-group v3 priv
end
write memory

cases.name: safe_ntp_auth_enable
cases.script:
configure terminal
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 7 0102030405
ntp authenticate
end
write memory

cases.name: safe_login_banner
cases.script:
configure terminal
banner login ^C Authorized access only. All activity is logged and monitored. ^C
end
write memory

cases.name: safe_fortinet_disable_http_resolved
cases.script:
config system global
 set admin-https-redirect enable
 set admin-sport 8443
end

cases.name: unsafe_widens_reachability_by_removing_access_class
cases.script:
line vty 0 15
 no access-class NETAUDIT-MGMT in
end

cases.name: unsafe_widens_reachability_by_removing_acl_deny
cases.script:
ip access-list standard NETAUDIT-MGMT
 no deny any log
exit

cases.name: safe_narrows_reachability_by_applying_access_class
cases.script:
ip access-list standard NETAUDIT-MGMT
 permit 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any log
exit
line vty 0 15
 access-class NETAUDIT-MGMT in
 transport input ssh
end
